request.name: F40d C104 — Fixed $3k Base
request.notes: Fixed $3k base. Anti-martingale: doubles after wins, resets on 5% DD. ETH-only edge.

deployed.name: F40d C104 — Fixed $3k Base
deployed.pineSource:
// Strategy: F40d C104 — FIXED $2k BASE
// Identical to strategy_v2.pine (original) with two changes:
//   1. baseCash = 2000.0 (was 30000.0)
//   2. Compilation fixes for trader-dev: commission constant + EMA proxy
//@version=5
strategy("F40d C104 — Fixed $3000 Base", overlay=true,
     initial_capital=10000,
     commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.04,
     slippage=2, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true)

adxThresh  = input.int(20,    "ADX Threshold",         minval=8,  maxval=35,  step=1)
slPct      = input.float(2.0, "Stop Loss %",           minval=1.0, maxval=5.0, step=0.25)
tpPct      = input.float(5.0, "Take Profit %",         minval=3.0, maxval=12.0, step=0.5)
growthRate = input.float(2.0, "Streak Growth Rate",    minval=1.1, maxval=2.5, step=0.1)
decayRate  = input.float(0.9, "Streak Decay Rate",     minval=0.2, maxval=0.9, step=0.1)
expansionZ = input.float(1.0, "Expansion Z-Threshold", minval=0.5, maxval=2.0, step=0.1)
minVelZ    = input.float(0.5, "Min Velocity Z-Score",  minval=0.2, maxval=1.5, step=0.1)
detrendLen = input.int(50,    "Detrend Length",        minval=30,  maxval=70,  step=5)
ddResetPct = input.float(5.0, "Streak Reset DD %",     minval=1.0, maxval=15.0, step=0.5)

adxLen          = 14
tr              = math.max(high - low, math.abs(high - nz(close[1], close)), math.abs(low - nz(close[1], close)))
up              = high - nz(high[1], high)
down            = nz(low[1], low) - low
plusDM          = up > down and up > 0 ? up : 0
minusDM         = down > up and down > 0 ? down : 0
smoothedTR      = ta.rma(tr, adxLen)
smoothedPlusDM  = ta.rma(plusDM, adxLen)
smoothedMinusDM = ta.rma(minusDM, adxLen)
plusDI          = 100 * smoothedPlusDM  / (smoothedTR + 1e-10)
minusDI         = 100 * smoothedMinusDM / (smoothedTR + 1e-10)
dx              = 100 * math.abs(plusDI - minusDI) / (plusDI + minusDI + 1e-10)
adx             = ta.rma(dx, adxLen)

// 200-day EMA proxy via 4800-bar 1H EMA — avoids request.security bar limit on perps
htfEMA200  = ta.ema(close, 4800)
regimeBull = close > htfEMA200
sideways   = adx < adxThresh

envSmoothLen = 10
envSlopeLen  = 10
envBaseLen   = 150
priceVelLen  = 5
useShorts    = true
baseCash     = 3000.0
amMultCap    = 3.0

atr14    = ta.atr(14)
normATR  = atr14 / close
refATR   = ta.sma(normATR, 200)
volRatio = normATR / math.max(refATR, 1e-10)
volMult  = math.max(1.0, math.min(1.5, volRatio))

trend   = ta.sma(close, detrendLen)
osc     = nz(close - trend)
quad    = 0.0962 * osc + 0.5769 * nz(osc[2]) - 0.5769 * nz(osc[4]) - 0.0962 * nz(osc[6])
envInst = math.sqrt(osc * osc + quad * quad)
env     = ta.ema(envInst, envSmoothLen)
envSlope     = env - nz(env[envSlopeLen], env)
envSlopeMean = nz(ta.sma(envSlope, envBaseLen))
envSlopeStd  = ta.stdev(envSlope, envBaseLen)
envExpZ      = (envSlope - envSlopeMean) / math.max(nz(envSlopeStd), 1e-10)

priceVel     = close - nz(close[priceVelLen], close)
priceVelMean = nz(ta.sma(priceVel, envBaseLen))
priceVelStd  = ta.stdev(priceVel, envBaseLen)
priceVelZ    = (priceVel - priceVelMean) / math.max(nz(priceVelStd), 1e-10)

expansionEdge = ta.crossover(envExpZ, expansionZ)
ready         = bar_index > detrendLen + envBaseLen + 50

goLong  = expansionEdge and priceVel > 0 and math.abs(priceVelZ) > minVelZ and regimeBull and not sideways
goShort = expansionEdge and priceVel < 0 and math.abs(priceVelZ) > minVelZ and not sideways

signalMult = math.max(1.0, math.min(3.0, math.abs(priceVelZ) / 1.0))

var float streakMult = 1.0
var float eqAtEntry  = na
var float peakEquity = na
var float prevPos    = 0.0

if na(peakEquity)
    peakEquity := strategy.equity
if strategy.equity > peakEquity
    peakEquity := strategy.equity
ddFromPeak = (peakEquity - strategy.equity) / math.max(peakEquity, 1e-10) * 100
if ddFromPeak > ddResetPct
    streakMult := 1.0
    peakEquity := strategy.equity

curPos      = strategy.position_size
posChanged  = curPos != prevPos
justEntered = posChanged and prevPos == 0.0 and curPos != 0.0
justExited  = posChanged and prevPos != 0.0 and curPos == 0.0

if justEntered
    eqAtEntry := strategy.equity

if justExited
    pnl = strategy.equity - nz(eqAtEntry, strategy.equity)
    if pnl > 0
        streakMult := math.min(amMultCap, streakMult * growthRate)
    else
        streakMult := math.max(1.0, streakMult * decayRate)

prevPos := curPos

effCash = baseCash * volMult * signalMult * streakMult
effQty  = effCash / close

if not regimeBull and strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.close("Long", comment="bear-exit")
if sideways and strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.close("Long",  comment="sideways-exit")
    strategy.close("Short", comment="sideways-exit")
if goShort and strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.close("Long", comment="flip-short")
if goLong and strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.close("Short", comment="flip-long")

if goLong and ready
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=effQty)
if useShorts and goShort and ready
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, qty=effQty)

strategy.exit("L-brk", from_entry="Long",
     limit=strategy.position_avg_price * (1 + tpPct / 100),
     stop =strategy.position_avg_price * (1 - slPct / 100))
if useShorts
    strategy.exit("S-brk", from_entry="Short",
         limit=strategy.position_avg_price * (1 - tpPct / 100),
         stop =strategy.position_avg_price * (1 + slPct / 100))

plot(htfEMA200, "200d EMA", color=color.purple, linewidth=2)
bgcolor(regimeBull ? color.new(color.green, 95) : color.new(color.red, 95))
